proposed.text: How must conduit and piping be fabricated and installed relative to reinforcement?

options.text: So reinforcement can be displaced freely in the field.
So reinforcement cutting is decided after concrete placement.
So cutting, bending, or displacement of reinforcement from its specified location is not required.
So reinforcement is omitted wherever pipes pass.

rationale.correct: Section 426.8 requires conduit and piping to be fabricated and installed so cutting, bending, or displacement of reinforcement from its specified location is not required.
rationale.takeaway: Pipe coordination must protect the specified reinforcement layout.
